author: mark
text:
v0.2 tests gate: verify end-to-end green, fix two flakes

Confirms the tests gate for the v0.2 epic (bl-4772):
- Full workspace cargo test: 116+62+19+15+13+11+3+2 tests green.
- v0.2 end-to-end integration test (tests/prompt_end_to_end.rs)
  exercises `lernie new` + `lernie prompt` against httpmock and
  asserts the ARCH §2.3/§2.6/§2.7 shape: ex/<ts>-<id> branch,
  snapshot-then-response step commits, terminal compactor summary
  (.agent/compactions/001.md reachable from main), --no-ff merge
  topology (main HEAD has two parents, second is the exchange tip),
  and no unmerged ex/* branches after merge — the branches.json
  check the epic originally asked for is now expressed via
  `git branch --no-merged` per bl-4652's single-source-of-truth
  retirement of the sidecar.
- tarpaulin --fail-under 100: 940/940 lines, 100% on workspace.

Two pre-existing flakes surfaced and were fixed in this task:
1. cli_outbound spawn tests raced on ETXTBSY when one thread's
   fs::write fd was still live during another thread's posix_spawn
   of the script it had just written. Serialized by module-level
   SPAWN_LOCK.
2. git_tree tests and the production git_tree::git helper did not
   scrub GIT_DIR/GIT_INDEX_FILE/etc. When cargo tarpaulin ran from
   the precommit hook context, the test `git -C tmpdir init` was
   re-initializing the outer repo. Scrubbed the same inherited-env
   list that src/template/mod.rs already handles.

Also fixes a clippy 1.94 while-let-on-iterator lint and a rustfmt
drift across several files.
